research_rationale: Full frozen dossier newly holds ACTOR_TEXT:EO12741: the complete immediate directive changes original §4(b) December 31, 1990 to December 31, 1991. This source resolves the machine target-provision-not-located gap even though its spaced OCR defeated the provision locator. EO12785 then changes December 31, 1991 to December 31, 1992, before that amended sunset. Each amendment says hereby ordered and gives no delayed effective clause; December 31, 1990 and December 26, 1991 are execution-date inferences from the complete operative contexts, not automated signing-date adoption. Original §4(b) date text ends upon the first replacement; the remaining expressly Committee-dependent establishment, membership, functions, information and expense commands end December 31, 1992. Section 4(a), however, delegates Presidential FACA responsibilities without an express restriction to this Committee. To avoid silently treating a potentially independent delegation as ended by the Committee sunset, retain that command until the direct EO12869 §4(e) whole-order revocation, expressly effective September 30, 1993 under §6. The latest clause first-end, and thus whole-order end, is September 30, 1993. Original and all actor contexts were read, earlier term alternatives compared, no conflict is listed, and the post-1937 OFR catalog/corpus search is adequate bounded later-event coverage for this decision. Statutory accrued travel claims may survive but do not continue the Committee or this revoked executive delegation. No current-law or readiness finding is made.
